content: Table TABREF5 reflects that the BOW model provided the best results, both in terms of accuracy and F1-score. The best result achieved by a sentiment model was the Stanford Sentiment ($0.63$ F1-score), with others within the same range and linguistic-based features collectively giving the best performance.
